title: Kobalos Linux Backdoor Investigation
description: Investigate a Kobalos Linux backdoor on a target host and identify its C2 IP address, port, and exfiltrated data.
prerequisites: Familiarity with SSH and network traffic analysis
outcomes: Identify the C2 IP address and port for a Kobalos Linux backdoor
Locate exfiltrated data from the Kobalos malware
Analyze network traffic to identify suspicious activity

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: Welcome to the Kobalos Linux Backdoor Investigation scenario. Your goal is to investigate a Kobalos backdoor on a target host and identify its C2 IP address, port, and exfiltrated data.

levels.title: Access Target Host
levels.cloud_content: Access the target host using SSH with the provided credentials.
levels.local_content:
Connect to the target host via SSH using the following command:

`ssh cyrano@192.168.50.5`

levels.title: Identify C2 IP Address
levels.content: Use netstat or tcpdump to identify the C2 IP address for the Kobalos backdoor.
levels.solution:
To find the C2 IP address, use the following command:

`netstat -an | grep LISTEN | grep 7070`

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Check for open connections on port 7070.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Use netstat to view network connections and look for the Kobalos backdoor's C2 IP address.

levels.title: Identify C2 Port
levels.content: Determine the C2 port for the Kobalos backdoor.
levels.solution:
To find the C2 port, use the following command:

`netstat -an | grep LISTEN | grep 151.80.57.191`

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Look for the C2 IP address in the output of netstat.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Find the port number associated with the C2 IP address.

levels.title: Identify Exfiltrated Data
levels.content: Locate the exfiltrated data from the Kobalos malware.
levels.solution: To find the exfiltrated data, look for unusual file transfers or suspicious activity on the target host, focusing on SSH credentials as a potential target of the Kobalos malware.

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Check for unusual file transfers or suspicious activity on the target host.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Focus on SSH credentials as a potential target of the Kobalos malware.
